<h2>Metal Shader Support — Full Metal Shading Language IDE for JetBrains</h2>

<p>
Build high-performance GPU shaders with full IDE power. Metal Shader Support delivers comprehensive Metal Shading Language support — from intelligent code completion with 300+ documented keywords to real-time shader preview and GPU profiling. Supports Metal 3.2 and Metal 4.0 for iOS, macOS, and visionOS development.
</p>

<h3>Language Support</h3>
<ul>
  <li>Full Metal 3.2 and Metal 4.0 syntax highlighting</li>
  <li>Keywords: kernel, vertex, fragment, device, threadgroup</li>
  <li>Types: float4, texture2d, sampler, matrices, vectors</li>
  <li>Attributes: [[texture(0)]], [[buffer(0)]], [[stage_in]]</li>
  <li>300+ built-in functions with inline documentation</li>
  <li>Raytracing and mesh shader support (Metal 4.0)</li>
</ul>

<h3>Code Editing</h3>
<ul>
  <li>Context-aware code completion with parameter hints</li>
  <li>10 live templates for vertex, fragment, and compute shaders</li>
  <li>Code folding, formatting, and structure view</li>
  <li>Comment/uncomment, brace matching, quote handling</li>
  <li>Find usages and documentation provider</li>
</ul>

<h3>Error Detection and Analysis</h3>
<ul>
  <li>Real-time threadgroup size validation (max 1024 threads)</li>
  <li>Texture access bounds checking</li>
  <li>Attribute format validation</li>
  <li>Vector swizzle validation</li>
  <li>Performance inspection with optimization hints</li>
</ul>

<h3>Pro Features</h3>
<ul>
  <li>Live shader preview at 60 FPS in a dedicated tool window</li>
  <li>Metal debugger panel with variable inspection</li>
  <li>GPU profiler with cycle estimation and bottleneck detection</li>
  <li>Shader optimizer with one-click apply</li>
  <li>Shader complexity analyzer</li>
</ul>

<h3>Enterprise Features</h3>
<ul>
  <li>Cross-platform transpiler: Metal to SPIR-V, HLSL, and WGSL</li>
  <li>Team collaboration features</li>
  <li>CI/CD integration</li>
</ul>

<h3>Pricing</h3>
<ul>
  <li><b>Free:</b> Syntax highlighting, code completion, live templates, error detection, formatting</li>
  <li><b>Pro ($49/year):</b> Live preview, debugger panel, GPU profiler, shader optimizer</li>
  <li><b>Enterprise ($199/year):</b> Cross-platform transpiler, team collaboration, CI/CD integration</li>
</ul>

<h3>Requirements</h3>
<ul>
  <li>IntelliJ IDEA 2024.1+ / CLion 2024.1+ / AppCode 2024.1+</li>
  <li>Java 21 or higher</li>
  <li>macOS recommended (Metal is an Apple-only framework)</li>
</ul>
